name: go9_se_ownership
hypothesis: SE+GP + 10 epochs + ROM + ownership prediction (KataGo's 1.65x improvement). Ownership gives 361 bits of learning signal per game vs 1 bit from win/loss. Combined with 10 epochs (47% better) and ROM (5.5% better), this should be our strongest experiment.
estimated_time: 10h (500 iters, ownership adds ~10% compute over se_10ep_rom)
success_criteria: Loss below 1.0 by iter 200. If loss plateaus above 1.2 for 100+ iters, kill. Compare directly against se_10ep_rom (same but without ownership).
notes: Same as se_10ep_rom but with use_ownership_head=True and ownership_loss_weight=0.02. No PSW, no shaped_dirichlet (both shown to hurt). Uses C++ MCTS with native ownership collection.
